params.name: selector
params.description: Path key designating a theme, page, or group of parameters in the Preferences or Settings dialog box (e.g. "/Database/Compiler"); a lone "/" opens the first page of the Database Settings dialog box.

sentinelValues.meaning: Lock every other page of the dialog box; only the page named by selector remains active/modifiable.
Leave all pages of the dialog box accessible (default if omitted).

params.name: settingsType
params.description: Only meaningful for databases configured in 'User settings' mode; a constant from the '4D Environment' theme.

overloads.semanticRole: Opens the 4D Preferences or the current application's Settings dialog box, displaying the theme/page/parameters designated by the selector path key, optionally locking the other pages (access) and choosing which settings store to target (settingsType).

constraints: selector is a path key of the form '/Dialog{/Page{/Parameters}}' (Dialog is '4D' for Preferences or 'Database' for Database Settings); passing an invalid key displays the first page of the Database Settings dialog box.
The set of valid selector keys differs between standard ('Structure settings') mode and 'User settings'/'User settings for data file' mode (settingsType 1/2 only accept a restricted subset of keys).
